title: Massive scalar field perturbations in noncommutative-geometry-inspired Schwarzschild black hole
summary: In this paper, based on noncommutative-geometry-inspired Schwarzschild black hole, we employ a third-order WKB approximation approach to systematically calculate the quasinormal mode frequencies (QNFs), greybody factors (GFs), and absorption cross section (ACS) under massive scalar field perturbations. The results show that the QNFs satisfy Im($ω$)<0, confirming the stability of the black hole under perturbations.
